chain.text: Mont Ventoux observatory: 60-cm reflector (2017) and 20-cm outreach refractor. ~195 useful nights/year (168 in 2024). ~400 GB/month archived nightly to Marseille (40 min). New main camera (March 2025) has 30% lower read noise but needs a full-night offline firmware update. Incidents: 2023 dome motor seizure bent a counterweight rod (fixed, limit switch added); February 2025 lost three weeks of photometry from an unnoticed 1.2-s timestamp offset (now GPS-checked each session). Rules: no observing during outreach evenings; raw frames compressed, never deleted; software changes need a test night. Proposed Spanish collaboration awaits evaluation of a shared scheduling tool and network capacity.
